Tesla FSD is preventing crashes on real roads, in real traffic, every day.

Per Tesla's official safety report: 10 billion total miles driven on FSD (Supervised), with 3.77 billion of those in city traffic. Tesla says FSD improves US road safety by over 80%.

What that means at scale, using NHTSA's 2023 fatality and injury data:
~ 32,000+ lives potentially saved per year 
~ 1.9 million injuries potentially avoided per year 
~ Cuts into the 30% of fatalities tied to drunk driving, the 29% from speeding, the 29% from distracted driving and the 44% from unbelted occupants

61.1% and counting. ⚡️

Tesla officially leads U.S. brand loyalty as of February 2026, beating out Subaru, Toyota, and even Ferrari. Between the Supercharger network and FSD tech, once you drive a Tesla, there’s no going back.

The numbers don't lie: Tesla owners are in it for the long haul.

Gas owners are cooked. Owning a Tesla will save you.

There are over 7 million cellular towers on Earth. Starlink Mobile is making them optional.

650+ Starlink satellites now act as cell towers from orbit, connecting directly to standard LTE phones with no special hardware. 

Texting and basic data already work in dead zones. Voice and high-speed data are next.

The whole tower-based model of cellular infrastructure has 10 years left, max.

SpaceX caught a 232-foot Super Heavy booster mid-air using two robotic arms attached to the launch tower.
Returning a rocket booster to land has been done. Catching one out of the sky on the way down had never been attempted by anyone. SpaceX did it on the first try, in October 2024, with the world watching live.
That single moment changed what's considered possible in aerospace engineering.

S.E. Robinson, Jr. (@SERobinsonJr)

SPACEX / TERAFAB: The County of Grimes, Texas, will be home to SpaceX's Multiphase, next gen, vertically integrated semiconductor manufacturing and advanced computing fabrication facility.

Estimated capital for initial phase is $55 billion. Estimated total investment of $119 billion.

The agreement covers the SpaceX Reinvestment Zone No. 1 – 2026-001 located at Gibbons Creek Reservoir and surrounding areas.

A public hearing will be held June 3rd.
